item.description: - Improved Kontakt library detection on macOS and Windows while excluding unrelated products. - Added batch operations for adding, repairing, and removing libraries with a single administrator authorization. - Added multi-library repair with a preview and automatic exclusion of healthy libraries. - macOS now processes batch changes transactionally and can roll them back if an error occurs. - Windows now uses native operations for improved performance. - Classic-order errors no longer prevent libraries from being removed successfully. - Fixed multi-library additions on macOS and Windows so already registered libraries are skipped while the remaining selected libraries continue installing.
